clips.title: The story
paras: Basilisks in harsh Kalimdor lands yield Crystalized Scales for arcane work. The mineralized hides come from the Charred Vale and Thousand Needles, and Collin Mauren seeks them in Stormwind.

Basilisks endure heat and ash in Stonetalon's Charred Vale and the salt flats of Thousand Needles. Their hides harden beneath a crystal crust, and the scales hold latent arcane resonance. Wizards across the Great Sea prize them for experiments in rare spellcraft.

In Stormwind, the mage Collin Mauren seeks travelers bound for Kalimdor to bring him these scales. Mauren pulverizes their crystalline mineral layers into dust, then uses the powder as a reagent for newly conceived spells and his own arcane research.
